promptSummary: Bakery: Bluebird Bakery, Chicago IL (bluebird-bakery.example). Does this bakery already take online orders? Find: how customers place an order today, how many locations it runs, and who owns or manages it. Cite the page you took each fact from.
teachingNote: One tool, used once. The model asks for the home page, the build runs the tool, the text comes back, and the model answers from it. Every fact now has a URL behind it. For this bakery one page is nearly enough, and the model says plainly which page it would read next.

modelTurns.assistantText: I need the bakery's own words. I will read https://bluebird-bakery.example/ first.

From the Bluebird Bakery home page (https://bluebird-bakery.example/): Bluebird Bakery is a single neighborhood bakery and coffee counter at 15 Example Street in the Lincoln Square part of Chicago, open Wednesday to Sunday, 7am to 2pm. Locations: one. The page says "There is one Bluebird. There has only ever been one Bluebird." Who runs it: "Bluebird is Hannah and Pete Kowalski. Hannah bakes. Pete runs the counter, keeps the books." How orders are taken: the home page shows no order button, no cart and no link to an ordering service. It gives a phone number, 312-555-0106, and says whole-cake and large bread orders start "with a conversation with one of us, not with a form." That points to phone or in-person ordering, but the details are on a separate Cakes and orders page (https://bluebird-bakery.example/order) that I have not read, so I cannot yet quote the bakery saying it outright.
